description: Compute text similarity using local algorithms (Bag of Words, TF-IDF, Character N-grams). No API key needed — runs entirely in-process. NOT real embeddings: for true semantic similarity with vector embeddings, use run_semantic_tests with mode="embeddings" and your OpenAI API key. Supports single pair or batch mode with pipe-separated pairs. Useful for RAG retrieval testing, semantic search evaluation, and text deduplication.

batch.description: Batch mode: array of { text_a, text_b } pairs. Overrides text_a/text_b if provided.

methods.description: Algorithms to use (default: all three). Options: "bow", "tfidf", "ngram"

name: embedding_similarity
